title: C: Caesar Cipher
description: Implement the Caesar cipher encryption and decryption algorithms.

steps.title: Encrypt and Decrypt
steps.description: Write functions `void encrypt(char *text, int shift)` and `void decrypt(char *text, int shift)` that shift each letter by the given amount (wrapping around the alphabet). Test with 'Hello, World!' shifted by 3.
hints: Only shift letters a-z and A-Z.

verification.failureMessage: Encrypt and then decrypt the message
